home.heroSub: From idea to interface. From code to cloud. From data to growth.
home.statementSub: Gravityy Studio designs, builds and automates websites, apps and the systems behind them, for founders and growing teams.

steps.line: First we find what holds you back.
steps.note: Workshops, audits and interviews, so the plan fixes the real constraint.

steps.line: Then we fix the scope and the price.
steps.note: Success metrics and a dated, fixed plan that everyone signs off on.

steps.line: We ship to staging every week.
steps.note: Design and build in weekly releases to a link you can click through.

steps.line: It goes live, then we measure.
steps.note: QA, speed and SEO checks, a calm launch, and dashboards from day one.

services.title: Services
services.lede: Everything your digital system needs, under one roof. Pick one, or combine them and see the estimate update live.
services.metaDescription: Brand, UI/UX, websites, web apps, mobile apps, e-commerce, automation, CRM, cloud, SEO and analytics — delivered by one team that owns the outcome.

solutions.title: Solutions
solutions.lede: Each engagement is scoped around a business result, then built from the services that get you there, measured end to end.
solutions.metaDescription: Launch systems, lead engines, sales ops, commerce stacks and data layers — engagements scoped around a business result, with live analytics and an engineered growth funnel.

work.title: Work
work.lede: Live client sites and the systems behind them. Open any project to see it running.
work.metaDescription: Live projects and case studies by Gravityy Studio: Viara Studios, ATHLEX, D2C commerce, B2B logistics, EdTech and fintech builds, and the results they produced.

process.title: Process
process.lede: A fixed, visible process so you always know what ships next, built on tools we know deeply and trust in production.
process.metaDescription: Eight steps from idea to scale (discover, define, design, build, automate, launch, measure, scale) on a modern, proven stack.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.lede: Fixed-price builds and monthly growth plans, priced for India and international clients. Need something custom? Build an estimate below.
pricing.metaDescription: Fixed-price website builds and monthly Grow plans for India (₹) and international (USD) clients, plus a live estimate for any combination of services.
